_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_measured_on: the bulletin release, 2026-08-17, twenty-nine packs and twenty-nine kits, clean tree
_raised: 3222/1811/615 -> 3333/1912/629 on the bulletin release, 2026-08-17. One pack plus one kit plus two reciprocal fork edits: validate.py gains the twenty-ninth pack's structure, routing, mirror and kit checks and the two link-back assertions the fork creates, the palette gate gains both theme blocks of a new token layer, and the slop lint gains the pack's prose and its kit CSS.
